3. **Ride from your office (456 Park Avenue) to your friend’s house (321 Elm Street)** – I’ll find a ride that costs no more than $20.  
4. **Ride from your friend’s house (321 Elm Street) back to your home (123 Main Street)** – I’ll find a ride that costs no more than $25.
